c = [0] * 35
temp = m
index = 0
valid = True

while temp > 0:
    c[index] += temp % w
    if c[index] == w:
        c[index] = 0
        c[index + 1] += 1
    if c[index] > 1:
        if c[index] == w - 1:
            c[index + 1] += 1
        else:
            valid = False
            break
    temp //= w
    index += 1

print("YES" if valid else "NO")
